description: Council deliberation proposal. Typically transmitted as the plaintext body of an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record (innerType=this NSID) so council membership scopes who can read. Per ADR-2605181100 + uhl-right-neural council pattern.

body.description: Discussion body. Markdown allowed. Larger documents should be referenced by `attachments` IPFS CID instead of inlined.

author.description: DID of the council member who proposed.

refs.description: Related AT URIs (prior proposals, evidence records, etc.).

attachments.description: IPFS CIDs for large attachments. Encryption of the attachment payload is the caller's responsibility (typically same symmetric key as the envelope, separately AEAD'd).
